decisions.reason: The MMAK concept has a quantified customer result of over 600,000 euros saved per year, so the option is proving its value and costs little to keep alongside its sibling line C.
The mobile slow-speed shredder sits close to the core offer and has kept its own page for two years, so keeping it is cheap even though the newer shredder line E could eventually absorb it.
This flagship MMAK line has a named reference customer and documented savings, so the uncertainty is resolving favourably and justifies further commitment.
The slow-speed shredder line was launched only in 2024 and its prospects are still uncertain, and as a low-cost extension of the core offer it is an option worth keeping open.
The spiral shaft screen line is newly launched with no negative signals, so it has had too little time to reveal its value and holding it costs little.
